title: trackerRunReport
responsibility: Summarize completed Tracker attempts for the legacy model report and historical ladder learning.

inputs.name: trackerModelHistory.rows
inputs.description: Snapshot of run attempts, including model rung, status and outcome.

inputs.name: trackerModelHistory.scope
inputs.description: Project and work type used to choose the nearest comparable history.

inputs.name: trackerModelHistory.minSamples
inputs.description: Minimum finished success and failure samples required for a comparable group.

inputs.name: trackerRunReport.rows
inputs.description: Run attempts from both local and replicated histories, keyed by node and run ID.

inputs.name: trackerRunReport.costFor
inputs.description: Supplies the recorded estimate or price bounds for each finished attempt.

outputs.name: trackerModelHistory
outputs.description: Success and failure counts by model rung for the best comparable group, or an empty map.

outputs.name: trackerRunReport
outputs.description: Sorted attempt outcomes, measured durations, and API-equivalent cost estimates with coverage by rung and work type.
